summary: Draw every new seed from a registered QRNG source (ANU keyed and keyless, Outshift, Quandela) and enforce run-time seed flags through qrng references, the CLI default or repro:N, with a consumption ledger keyed by script, flag and experiment.

reconciliation.note: Merged in PRs #433, #435 and #436; every step's acceptance rerun on main.

scope: QRNG draw adapters (ANU keyed and keyless, Outshift, Quandela /qt/qrng/ints), their source registry in ci/seed_provenance.py, the provider guide, and run-time seed flags with a consumption ledger across the CLIs that take a seed.
next_action: None; a QCi uQRNG source opens its own record when the token arrives.

steps.action: Write scripts/outshift_qrng.py: draw, check and self-test over retained raw responses under docs/evidence/outshift_qrng/, key in ~/.config/outshift-qrng/api-key.
steps.acceptance: The self-test rejects disagreeing representations, a wrong block width and an edited raw byte; check admits the retained probe draw.

receipts.result: outshift_qrng.py --self-test rejects 5 mutations (disagreeing representations, block width, edited raw byte among them); check admits the retained 4-block probe draw. Merged in PR #435.

steps.action: Write scripts/quandela_qrng.py over GET /qt/qrng/ints with draws gated on an approved written case.
steps.acceptance: The self-test admits a well-formed response and rejects edits; a draw without --approved-case refuses before any request.

receipts.result: quandela_qrng.py --self-test rejects 6 mutations of a well-formed response; draw without --approved-case exits at argument parsing before any request. Merged in PR #435.

steps.action: Register each source's evidence directory and admit function in SOURCES of gororoba_quantum/qrng_seeds.py, which ci/seed_provenance.py and the seed flags import, and accept allocations from any registered source.
steps.acceptance: The self-test admits an allocation from each registered source and refuses an unregistered directory.

receipts.result: seed_provenance.py --self-test admits a retained draw from each SOURCES directory and refuses an allocation naming docs/evidence/unregistered/ (19 mutations rejected). Merged in PRs #435 and #436.

steps.action: Write docs/notes/qrng/README.md: sources, fallback order, quotas, key files, approval rules, with a docs/README.md map row.
steps.acceptance: scripts/check_markdown_links.py passes and the AGENTS.md Seeds rule links the guide.

receipts.result: check_markdown_links.py resolves every link in 511 Markdown files; AGENTS.md Seeds links docs/notes/qrng/README.md and docs/README.md carries its map row. Merged in PR #435.

steps.action: Give every CLI seed flag a type accepting qrng:<source>/<draw>#I, the CLI default or repro:N, and append consumption rows keyed by script, flag and experiment to the allocation ledger.
steps.acceptance: A bare non-default integer is refused at parse time on every seed flag; the ledger check refuses an index consumed under two experiment keys.

receipts.result: qrng_seeds self-test refuses a bare non-default integer at parse time; seed_provenance refuses a seed flag declared through bare add_argument outside the four flags that set no seed value, and its runtime self-test refuses an index consumed by two experiments; --runtime matches 0 retained references against the ledger. Eleven CLIs migrated. Merged in PR #436.

resolution: Every new seed draws from a registered QRNG source (ANU keyed and keyless, Outshift, Quandela on an approved case); run-time seed flags take qrng:<draw>#I, the CLI default or repro:N, and ci/seed_provenance.py binds each retained qrng reference to one ledger row. A QCi uQRNG adapter waits on the provider token and belongs to a successor record.

receipts.result: All five steps done with receipts at this revision.
